DB.description: Stores your agent sessions and events. A new D1 database is created for this server.

INGEST_TOKEN.description: Generate and save a random token of at least 32 characters in your password manager. Agent hooks use this token to send events.

CLIENT_TOKEN.description: Generate and save a different random token of at least 32 characters. Enter this token in the dashboard app to read and manage sessions.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Web app origins allowed to connect. The default includes the public Agent Dashboard web app.
